latest_release.name: v6.0.0
latest_release.body:
ARES is an operator dashboard and automation framework for authorized red-team validation, lab workflows, campaign orchestration, module execution, telemetry, reporting, API key management, RBAC, and security validation.

Highlights:
- React operator dashboard
- FastAPI backend
- Campaign and module orchestration
- API key lifecycle management
- HTML report generation
- Security audit snapshot
- Validation lab script
- GitHub Actions CI
- 1078 unit tests passing

This project is intended for authorized security testing, lab use, and defensive validation only.

detail.readme:
### Operator-directed red team orchestration & continuous security validation Prove exploitability. Compute shortest paths to Crown Jewels. Ship audit-ready evidence. Built for enterprise red teams, MSSPs and security operations centers that need to validate defensive posture continuously, not once a year.
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-v6.0--enterprise-DC2626?style=flat-square)](releases/) [![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.11%2B-3776AB?style=flat-square&logo=python&logoColor=white)](https://python.org) [![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/backend-FastAPI-009688?style=flat-square&logo=fastapi&logoColor=white)](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com) [![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/frontend-React%2018%20%7C%20Vite-61DAFB?style=flat-square&logo=react&logoColor=111111)](https://react.dev) [![MITRE ATT&CK](https://img.shields.io/badge/coverage-MITRE%20ATT%26CK-FF6F00?style=flat-square)](docs/modules.md) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-3B82F6?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-5%2C074-22C55E?style=flat-square)](tests/) [**Quickstart**](#quickstart) · [**Screens**](#screens) · [**Features**](#features) · [**Docs**](docs/) · [**Security**](docs/security-model.md) · [**Sponsor**](#support)
--- ## What ARES is A self-hosted platform that runs **real** offensive validation modules inside a fail-closed scope enclave, maps attack paths on an interactive DAG, and produces branded reports, so your SOC sees exactly what an attacker could reach today, not what a scanner thinks might be a problem. **Not just a scanner.** ARES only reports what it actually proved on a live target, including the multi-stage chain used to prove it. > **Why not a traditional pentest or a vulnerability scanner?** See the [market comparison matrix](docs/comparison.md). --- ## Screens

*Sign-in with the ARES mascot and the SSO fallback. Memory-only JWT access tokens, HttpOnly rotating refresh.*

*Operator overview: active engagements, validated findings, attack surface, engine health, telemetry pulse.*

*Catalog: 66 active modules across 13 categories, each annotated with MITRE ATT&CK techniques and OPSEC noise level.*

*Results: finding card with severity, confidence, remediation and one-click pivot to the next module.*

*Attack graph: perimeter firewall (fire animation), targets, pivot edges. Read-only beacon telemetry per node.*

*Campaign scope: target campaign picker, Restore Vault / Dry-Run Plan / Delete controls.*
--- ## Features - **Fail-closed scope enclave**: dual-layer ScopeGuard (application pre-check + OS/transport firewall) guarantees zero offensive packets reach out-of-scope hosts. [→ security model](docs/security-model.md) - **Goal-directed attack planning**: set `domain_admin` or `cloud_audit`, and the decision engine synthesizes multi-stage execution paths (graph heuristics, optional LLM agents under explicit authorization). [→ engine design](docs/engine_design.md) - **Multi-vector attack graph (DAG)**: ingest BloodHound or map sessions in real time. Shortest-path, chokepoints, lateral pivot feasibility. [→ attack graph](docs/engine_design.md) - **Zero-trust auth model**: memory-only short-lived JWTs, HttpOnly rotating refresh, HMAC CSRF, AES-256-GCM AEAD vault (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 600k). [→ security model](docs/security-model.md) - **66 active production modules** across 60+ MITRE ATT&CK techniques (AD, cloud, credential access, exfil, lateral, recon, Windows, Linux, EDR). [→ module catalog](docs/modules.md) - **Automated deliverables**: one-click branded PDF/HTML/Markdown/JSON reports via headless browser (no GTK deps on Windows/Linux). [→ dashboard guide](docs/dashboard-guide.md) - **MCP Gateway**: Cursor/Claude Desktop/Windsurf/Cline can drive ARES safely under Pre-Flight ScopeGuard, anti-prompt-injection taint isolation and single-use HMAC confirmation tokens. [→ MCP spec](docs/mcp-server.md) - **Type-safe Python SDK**: write custom modules with `BaseModule[P, R]` + `@ares_module`, simulate in `ModuleTestHarness`, automate with `AresClient`. [→ SDK docs](docs/module_sdk.md) · [→ module dev guide](docs/module-development.md) --- ## Quickstart ### Prerequisites - **Python** 3.11 or 3.12 (3.12 recommended on Windows) - **Node.js** v18+ (tested on v20 LTS) - **OS** Windows 11/10, Linux (Ubuntu/Debian/Kali) or macOS ### 60 seconds (PowerShell on Windows) ```powershell git clone https://github.com/Mafifrizi/ARES.git Set-Location .\ARES py -3.12 -m venv .venv .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -U pip .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -e ".[dev,pdf]" Set-Location frontend ; & "C:\Program Files\nodejs\npm.cmd" ci ; Set-Location .. $env:ARES_PDF_BROWSER = "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe" .\.venv\Scripts\ares.exe doctor --pdf-smoke .\.venv\Scripts\ares.exe dashboard dev --no-reload ``` Open `http://127.0.0.1:5173/dashboard/`. Initial operator: `admin`. Password: set `ARES_DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD` in `.env` (mandatory, minimum 12 characters, no hardcoded default). ### Tests ```powershell pytest tests/unit -n auto -q # 5,074 tests, parallel pytest tests/integration/test_postgres_*.py -q # Postgres integration ``` ### In-place upgrades (no git clone / rebuild needed) ```powershell ares update # add new modules only ares upgrade # full-system upgrade (core + db + modules + UI) ares upgrade --check # preview, no changes on disk ``` User databases, credentials, config and plugins are mathematically blacklisted from modification. See [in-place upgrade guarantees](docs/execution-policy.md). --- ## Documentation Everything deep lives in [`docs/`](docs/). The main entry points: - [**Quickstart engagement guide**](QUICKSTART.md) - [**Documentation portal & subsystem index**](docs/README.md) - [**Dashboard surface-by-surface manual**](docs/dashboard-guide.md) - [**Module catalog & schemas**](docs/modules.md) · [**Module development**](docs/module-development.md) · [**SDK spec**](docs/module_sdk.md) - [**API reference**](docs/api-reference.md) · [**MCP gateway**](docs/mcp-server.md) · [**Enterprise SSO (SAML/OIDC)**](docs/sso-setup.md) - [**Security & threat model**](docs/security-model.md) · [**Execution policy**](docs/execution-policy.md) · [**Validation lab**](docs/validation-lab.md) - [**Architecture**](docs/architecture.md) · [**Engine design**](docs/engine_design.md) · [**Worker architecture**](docs/worker_architecture.md) · [**Database migrations**](docs/database-migrations.md) - [**Market comparison**](docs/comparison.md) · [**RFC 001: Linux AD cross-platform tradecraft**](docs/research/linux-active-directory-tradecraft.md) --- ## Support If ARES has accelerated your assessments or protected your infrastructure, consider sponsoring continued feature development, threat research and lab infrastructure:
